# Document Assistant RAG Project Instructions

This is a Document Assistant RAG (Retrieval Augmented Generation) system that allows users to upload documents and ask questions about their content.

## Project Components
- FastAPI backend for document processing and Q&A
- Streamlit frontend for user interaction
- Advanced text chunking and splitting
- Vector embeddings using free models
- LLM integration with scope validation
- Vector database for document storage and retrieval

## Development Guidelines
- Use Python 3.8+ with modern libraries
- Implement proper error handling and logging
- Follow best practices for RAG implementation
- Ensure scalable architecture for document processing
